column1: # Julia-layer exception-taxonomy ratchet (Issue #11146, Phase 2a of #10813).
# Each row: a pure-Julia source file under subset_julia_vm/src/julia/ that still
# raises a Julia exception class by NAMING it in an `error("<Class>: ...")`
# message — which throws an `ErrorException`, so `typeof(caught)` contradicts the
# message and an `isa`-dispatching `catch` takes the wrong branch. The same
# defect the Rust-side funnel (VmError::exception_class) makes impossible.
# The message-only classes (ArgumentError, DimensionMismatch — 64 sites) were
# converted to `throw(<Class>("msg"))` in Issue #11146; their rendered output is
# byte-identical (ErrorException's showerror prints the bare message, so the
# "<Class>: " prefix was already doing the class's job in text only).
# The classes below need CONSTRUCTOR ARGUMENTS the raise site does not currently
# carry (`BoundsError(a, i)` wants the container and the index; `DomainError(val,
# msg)` the offending value; `InexactError(func, args)` the conversion), so they
# are a mechanical-but-not-trivial retirement tracked as a follow-up rather than
# smuggled into the funnel PR.
# Issue #11146 also retired the 2 DomainError sites in base/range.jl's LogRange
# constructor (10 -> 8): upstream raises DomainError there, and the fixture that
# asserted ErrorException was wrong in the same direction, so both were fixed.
# RATCHET: check_exception_taxonomy_funnel.sh fails if any count GROWS or a new
# file appears. It never passes on an increase — the divergence count cannot
# drift back up silently while the retirement is pending.
